name: local-llm
description: On request, run bounded text jobs on big files (classify, extract, check claims) on a model running locally in LM Studio, over loopback only

allowed_dirs.title: Allowed folders
allowed_dirs.description: Folders the local model may read files from. Nothing outside them is readable. A leading $HOME or ~ is expanded; a folder name must not contain a comma.

endpoint_url.title: LM Studio endpoint
endpoint_url.description: Base URL of the LM Studio server. Keep it on loopback.

model.title: Model id
model.description: Model id to use. Leave empty to use whichever model LM Studio has loaded.

delegate_tasks.title: Delegated task kinds
delegate_tasks.description: Default off: on real files, delegated answers were usable 4/10 vs 8/10 when Claude read them, and cost 3% more. Opt in with a comma-separated value such as classify or classify,extract. Known read-only kinds: classify, extract, summarize, draft; enable only kinds measured as reliable on your local model.
